titel: With your nose pinched, you only taste sweet
kurz: A gummy bear eaten with your nose pinched only tastes sweet. Let go, and suddenly the fruit is there.
bild_im_kopf: Like a film without sound: you can see something happening, but only the sound tells the story.
beobachtung: With your nose pinched you only taste sweet and a little sour. As soon as your nose is free, you recognise strawberry, lemon or raspberry.
erklaerung: The tongue only recognises basic tastes such as sweet and sour. The fruit flavour is a scent. It rises into the nose from the back while you chew, but only if air can flow there.
schritte: Close your eyes and pinch your nose firmly.
The second person puts a gummy bear in your mouth.
Chew and guess which flavour it is.
Then let go of your nose and keep chewing.
material: a second person who chooses the colour
